What is WUD Aptitude Test?

The WUD Aptitude Test (WUDAT) is a university-level entrance exam conducted by the World University of Design to shortlist aspirants for admission to various UG and PG design courses offered by the institute.

Fill WUDAT Application Form

Candidates can fill out the WUDAT application form either offline or on the official website of the World University of Design. To apply offline, the candidate needs to download the application form from the college website or can ask for it by email or can collect it from the campus. Those going for offline mode can fill out the application forms and send them via email or post to World University of Design, Plot No.1, Rajiv Gandhi Education City, NH 1, Haryana - 131029
Pay the application fee
The application fee for WUDAT is INR 2,000/-, which can be paid by RTGS/NEFT bank transfer for online mode and by cash/cheque/ Demand Draft for offline mode.

Appear for WUDAT

Check results

Successful candidates will be made an offer of admission to join WUD. The offer will be sent via email. Details regarding payment of fees at the time of admission, allotment of Hostel and date, time and venue for commencement of the academic session will be included in the admission letter.

Offer of admission will be valid only for the particular programme opted for by the candidate in the given academic session. In acceptance of the offer of admission to WUD, the candidates will have to appear in person at the campus along with original documents for verification and pay the required fees.

CMAT percentile score is calculated from the scaled score. faqs.question: I scored less than 50 percent marks in Graduation. Am I eligible to apply for CMAT?
faqs.answer: Yes, you are eligible to apply for CMAT exam. Any candidate who has secured passing marks in graduation can apply for CMAT. Candidates must ensure that they have cleared graduation to be able to apply. Final year students planning to appear for the exam must ensure that they have passed the first two years of Bachelor's degree and must target passing marks in the final year as well. However, colleges accepting CMAT score for admission have a 50 per cent in graduation. The minimum score requirement for SC, ST, PwD candidates is 45 per cent as minimum criteria thus candidates must not target passing marks in graduation as even if they will clear CMAT. They might not get admission as they will not meet the institutes academic eligibility criteria.

faqs.question: Is there any age restriction to take CMAT exam?
faqs.answer: There is no age bar for appearing in CMAT exam. Any person at any phase of their career, from any field, fresher or working professionals, can appear for CMAT. However, the candidate should have completed graduation. The education mode can be full-time or correspondence but the university should be affiliated to the UGC. A graduation degree is normally completed by the age of 20 so the candidate must be at least 20 years old at the time of appearing in the CMAT exam. So, yes one can say that there is a minimum age limit but not maximum age limit for appearing in CMAT. A large percentage of CMAT applicants is of fresh graduates as it suits them better to continue education in full-time mode. However, many working professional also appear for the CMAT exam to purse executive MBA, Online MBA, Distance MBA or Part-Time MBA from reputed institutes.

faqs.question: Can I change my exam centre after the CMAT admit card has been issued?
faqs.answer: No. You cannot change the exam centre after the CMAT admit card has been issued. You cannot take the exam at any other centre other than the one mentioned in your admit card, either. So make an informed decision at time of selecting your test city in the CMAT application form. Select only those cities where you can make arrangement of stay on the CMAT exam day. Choose your home city or city of current residence as the first test city. The examination authorities try to allot the test centre to a candidate as per their first preference. However, sometimes if there are not enough number of applicants for a city, the centre may be cancelled there and candidates are allotted a test centre in the next city of preference. If at a particular exam centre in a city has already been filled with candidates, then the remaining students are allotted a test city in the next city of preference.

faqs.question: What details will be mentioned on the CMAT admit card?

You can prepare for it in the last couple of months with the help of year books as most of the questions are asked from Static GK.
